_note: Default container images for GEAK CI e2e runs (repo-tracked). resolve_image() in ci/lib.sh looks up [framework][arch]; arch is MI355 (gfx950/MI35x) or MI300 (gfx942/gfx90a/MI30x), auto-detected on the compute node (override with GEAK_GPU_ARCH). Override the whole choice with IMAGE=<repo:tag>. These are the primussafe 'profilerfix' images (ROCm 7.2.0); the vLLM image is built for both gfx942 and gfx950, fixing the stock vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:v0.21.0 torch eager SIGSEGV on gfx950.
